patterns: APPSC asks definitional one-liners: arbitrage, India's current regime (market-determined), FERA->FEMA, components of forex reserves (FCA, gold, SDR, RTP).
Assertion-reason on devaluation is the signature APPSC item: A (improves trade balance) true, R (raises export prices) false.
Recent APPSC Group-2 items: which is NOT an RBI tool for rupee volatility (fiscal policy), SDR form (book-keeping entries).
Other PSCs favour numeric quote reading (Rs 60 -> 58 = appreciation; 60 -> 65 = depreciation), devaluation years 1949/1966/1991, Tarapore = capital account convertibility.
App MCQs add many 2026 current-affairs figures (reserves rank, 96/$ crossing, swaps, FCNR(B) hedging) and long chronology items beyond the APPSC depth.
